intro: Three outbound campaigns inside India: a payroll firm, an employee benefits brokerage building referral partners, and a dermatology company reaching doctors across eight cities. Every number below comes from a real campaign.

audiences.title: Firms selling to Indian companies
audiences.body: Service providers that depend on referrals and want to reach HR heads, finance controllers and founders when they are actually reviewing a vendor.

audiences.title: Teams extending a field force
audiences.body: Pharma and healthcare companies that need to reach professionals in cities where their representatives have limited coverage.

plays.title: Qualify on vendor review timing
plays.body: A payroll firm targeting companies with 100 to 500 employees reached HR heads, finance controllers and founders. Follow-ups established workforce size, current process and when they planned to review vendors.

plays.title: Reach partners who already serve your buyers
plays.body: An employee benefits brokerage approached founders and practice heads at HR consultancies about complementary services, adding a referral channel alongside direct employer outreach.

plays.title: Cover the cities your field team can't
plays.body: A dermatology company launching a product built a city-wise list of dermatologists across eight cities and sent medical-team-approved webinar invitations with coordinated reminders.

rulesBody: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 centres on notice and consent, and its rules are still being phased in. TRAI rules govern commercial calls and SMS. We contact professionals in their business role, say who is writing and why, and honour every opt-out.
timingBody: Lists are built city by city, so campaigns can focus on the cities where your buyers or your coverage gaps are. The city pages below show the industries we write for in each one.
